name: clinical_agent_validation_default
comment: End-to-end Secretary/EchoMind agent validation through the live AI-PACS GUI and CommandBus. Default selects yesterday's first CT patient after proving an initial MRI list can load. Set patient_id for a fixed case. Measurement uses CommandBus image-space points when supplied by the scenario or external GPT/GapGPT brain.

external_brain.note: The local runner is only the orchestrator/executor. Patient, series, slice, and measurement decisions are delegated through modules.EchoMind.llm_client using the same EchoMind Secretary connection. Default AI-PACS deployment uses the company GapGPT backend; OpenAI is used only if EchoMind settings explicitly select OpenAI.

measurement.note: Preferred mode. The runner captures viewport context/screenshot, asks the external GPT/GapGPT brain for image-space points, then executes measure_distance through CommandBus. For deterministic QA, add points_image: [[x1,y1],[x2,y2]]. Legacy coordinate_drag remains available with absolute screen coordinates: tool_click, start, end.
